title: Recruiters Decide in 6 Seconds — Put This on Top of Your Resume!
description:
Recruiters decide whether to move you forward to an interview in about 6 seconds, and that decision is almost entirely based on the top of your resume.

In this YouTube Short, I explain why your resume headline, professional summary, and core competencies matter more than most job seekers realize, and why your strongest value must be in the top quarter of your resume.

Most people list experience.
Strong candidates show solutions.

I also share a quick AI resume hack to identify what a job is really designed to solve, so you can move the right skills and accomplishments to the top where recruiters actually look.

 I have a full video breaking down exactly how to build a resume that gets noticed in 6 seconds. It’s linked in the comments.

transcript: Recruiters decide in just 6 seconds if they're going to move forward and give you an interview. And it is entirely based on the top of your resume. That's why I like to do something called putting what's going to pop on top. Your summary and core competencies have to show with that value in the first quarter of your resume or you are going to get passed over. So stop listing experience and start thinking about the problem the role was designed to solve. When you position yourself as the candidate who solves that problem, you're the one who wins that interview. Most people list experience first. Strong candidates show the solutions. Quick hack. Paste a job description into AI and ask, "What problems is this job designed to solve?" Then move the accomplishments that prove you can solve those problems into your headline and professional summary. Make sure you put what's going to pop on top. I have a full video on everything you need to make a perfect resume that will get noticed in that first six seconds. It is linked in the comments. And don't forget to subscribe.
